taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-30, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 74.2 | 15.31 | 15.31
2 | 27.3 | 18.79 | 34.10
3 | 76.3 | 5.06 | 39.16
4 | 96.3 | 4.07 | 43.23
5 | 138.1 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HAA-type.

Is this label correct for these layer values? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"label_correct": true or false, "curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve type, we examine the resistivities of the layers in depth order:
- Layer 1: 74.2 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 2: 27.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 3: 76.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 4: 96.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 5: 138.1 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$

Next, we evaluate each group of three consecutive layers:
1. **Layers 1-2-3**: (74.2, 27.3, 76.3). Since $74.2 > 27.3 < 76.3$, this corresponds to the letter **H**.
2. **Layers 2-3-4**: (27.3, 76.3, 96.3). Since $27.3 < 76.3 < 96.3$, this corresponds to the letter **A**.
3. **Layers 3-4-5**: (76.3, 96.3, 138.1). Since $76.3 < 96.3 < 138.1$, this corresponds to the letter **A**.

The sequence of letters is HAA. The survey interpretation's classification of HAA-type is correct.

{"label_correct": true, "curve_type": "HAA"}
